ValidationRule.description: When a Royalty Term is referenced, the Transaction's Agreement and Agreement Party must match the Royalty Term's own Agreement and Agreement Party.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT(ISBLANK(Royalty_Term__c)), OR( AND(NOT(ISBLANK(Agreement__c)), Agreement__c <> Royalty_Term__r.Agreement__c), AND(NOT(ISBLANK(Agreement_Party__c)), Agreement_Party__c <> Royalty_Term__r.Agreement_Party__c) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: The Agreement and Agreement Party on this Transaction must match the Agreement and Agreement Party on the selected Royalty Term.
